name: Riot Platforms
industry_role: crypto-mining company pivoting to AI/HPC data center hosting
notes: Crypto-mining pivot: Q1 2026 was first quarter with real data-center revenue ($33.2M). 20-yr, 191MW lease with a frontier AI lab (reported as Anthropic) worth ~$9.1B; MOU with Terrestrial Energy for nuclear-powered AI/HPC campuses (up to ~4GW). Morgan Stanley provided $573M interim PROJECT FINANCING (debt, Aug 2026) for the Rockdale buildout via subsidiary Riot DC Logistics -- not recorded as an investor edge here since it's project debt, not equity.
